last_verified.normal_state: DIAG-01 host-testable diagnostics foundation passed on codex/ws-diagnostics at 2e748634272ab27a64fb6b55e02ca458c5e0a00e. The shared nagi-diagnostics crate provides structured/sanitized events, bounded sinks and crash capture, health registry, portable error reports, diagnostic snapshots, and an explicit typed Activity bridge. 72 CLI unit tests, 22 CLI integration tests, and 27 diagnostics tests pass; affected-package format/Clippy, bootstrap checks, pinned dependency fetch, and diagnostics/verify/host-smoke commands pass. A Windows CI run found host-native absolute-path parsing leaked POSIX source paths; the fix now recognizes POSIX, drive-rooted, and UNC paths independent of host OS, and the expanded regression test plus full focused suite pass locally. Run 36395201986 has Ubuntu success and the fixed Windows job failure; its independent M17 target job was cancelled by the next push. Retest run 36396121951 has both Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; the target job is building Nagi user init. DF-01 is absent in this branch and is reported SKIPPED. Repository-wide fmt reports existing fetched Servo formatting differences, while full host-workspace test/Clippy hits x86-64 libnagi assembly on this aarch64 host; neither affects scoped DIAG-01 acceptance.

release_line_gate.activation_requirement: This checkpoint provides host-side diagnostics contracts only. Guest crash persistence, target event collection, or production diagnostics service integration require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit release boundary.

do_not_try: Do not treat --vm smoke as evidence for the strict M17 first-web-pixel gate.
Do not add target crash persistence or guest event collection before the M30 plus explicit integration release gate.
Do not edit x86-64 libnagi assembly from the Diagnostics workstream or alter the existing M1/M7/M17 acceptance criteria.
Do not modify fetched third_party/servo files to silence repository-wide rustfmt output.
Do not upload local diagnostics reports unless the user explicitly selects an output path.

next_action: Wait for CI run 36396121951 target job completion and record that M17 acceptance result separately. Preserve the existing M17 status; keep DF-01 validator registration and target crash persistence behind their stated integration gates.
acceptance_criteria: Structured events and reports carry stable machine identities and bounded, redacted fields, and separate localization identity from event identity.
Memory/development sinks and bounded buffers sanitize data, contain sink failure, and do not wait indefinitely on the event-recording path.
Health states and registry represent subsystem transitions, scoped summaries, unavailable providers, duplicate registration, removal, and stale handles.
Portable error reports and diagnostic snapshots include only bounded safe context and support build, health, components, environment, and recent events.
Diagnostics, verify, and host smoke commands pass and keep reports local unless an explicit output path is requested.
Only explicit typed semantic Activity bridge candidates can be promoted; raw diagnostics are never automatically promoted.
When DF-01 is present, the workstreams health check reuses its authoritative validator; when absent, the check reports SKIPPED.
Diagnostics evidence does not change M17 or later milestone status and adds no guest persistence before the release gate.
deferred: Register the authoritative DF-01 state validator after its registry and validator are integrated into this source line.
Target crash persistence and guest event collection until Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit integration release gate.
M1/M7 QEMU smoke remains an independent existing acceptance boundary; no M17 first-web-pixel result is inferred.

cross_workstream_dependencies.contract: Reuse the DF-01 registry and state validator through nagi dev verify, and align failure classes to the accepted durable-state vocabulary.
